title: Skin Diary Entry Severity Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Curology prescriptions (`curology:prescription`), skin diaries (`skin:diary`), dermatology appointments (`derm:appointment`), and UV exposure logs (`uv:exposure`).
app: Curology prescription shipments, daily skin diary entries, dermatology appointment exports, and UV exposure tracker logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skin:diary severity_score=*
| stats sum(severity_score) as total_value, avg(severity_score) as avg_value by concern_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks concern values by total and average severity score across skin diary entry events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `severity_score` values for each skin diary entry event and review total and average severity score by concern.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total severity score.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which concern shows the biggest severity score numbers in your skin diary entry data.
